en_title: Xbox Reveals Original and 360 Boot-Up Options for 25th Anniversary
cn_title: XBOX公布25周年初代及360开机动画选项
opus_summary: 微软为庆祝XBOX品牌25周年，公布三款面向XBOX Series和XBOX One的开机动画，分别重现初代XBOX以及2005年和2010年的XBOX 360开机画面。相关更新将在当天陆续推出，微软还发布了介绍其游戏业务历史及未来计划的25周年纪念杂志。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft has revealed three new nostalgic Xbox console boot-up options for Xbox Series X/S and Xbox One as part of a new update for the brand's 25th anniversary.
paragraphs.cn: 作为品牌25周年新更新的一部分，微软公布了三个适用于XBOX Series和XBOX One的全新怀旧主机开机动画选项。

paragraphs.en: Xbox has been around a long time, and those who have stuck around for the full ride have seen it through plenty of ups and downs. To mark the occasion, the company revealed all of the old-school animations that players can enjoy as soon as a new update rolls out for Series and One devices today.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX已经走过了很长一段时间，一路陪伴至今的人们见证了它的许多起伏。为了纪念这一时刻，该公司公布了全部这些复古动画，玩家在今天面向Series和One设备的新更新推出后就能欣赏到它们。

paragraphs.en: These three new animations are largely untouched rips of the same boot-up videos from some of the earliest days of Microsoft's gaming endeavors. The Original is the same sci-fi-inspired introduction that played for original Xbox consoles. The other two options are Xbox 360-themed, with one being based on the 2005 startup and the other based on the 2010 startup.
paragraphs.cn: 这三个新动画直接提取自微软涉足游戏领域早期的开机视频，基本未作改动。初代选项与初代XBOX主机播放的科幻风格开机画面相同。另外两个选项以XBOX 360为主题，分别基于2005年和2010年的开机画面。

paragraphs.en: We’re bringing back the original XBOX boot-up animation for all XBOX Series X|S and XBOX One players, along with two additional XBOX 360 boot-up animations!
paragraphs.cn: 我们将为所有XBOX Series和XBOX One玩家带回初代XBOX开机动画，还有另外两个XBOX 360开机动画！

paragraphs.en: This update will be rolling out throughout the day and thank you for being part of 25 years of XBOX. https://t.co/V9SKMZTtPR
paragraphs.cn: 这项更新将在今天陆续推出，感谢你成为XBOX 25年历程的一部分。https://t.co/V9SKMZTtPR

paragraphs.en: Xbox has been going hard on the nostalgia to help celebrate its 25th anniversary today. In addition to the three new boot-up animations, Microsoft published the Xbox 25th Anniversary Magazine , which offered a full layout for the company's 25-year history in games and what's coming next.
paragraphs.cn: 为了庆祝今天的25周年纪念，XBOX大打怀旧牌。除了三个新的开机动画，微软还发布了《XBOX 25th Anniversary Magazine》，全面介绍了该公司25年的游戏历史以及未来的发展。

paragraphs.en: Part of the future includes plotting ahead for Project Helix , a project the company has previously described as a family of devices that could mark a new path forward for Xbox. It all arrives as Microsoft navigates a tough year for the brand, which has seen it introduce a new CEO in Asha Sharma and announce thousands of layoffs .
paragraphs.cn: 未来的计划包括为Project Helix作长远规划，该公司此前将这个项目描述为一个设备系列，可能为XBOX开辟一条新的发展道路。这一切都发生在微软应对该品牌艰难一年的过程中，期间公司任命Asha Sharma为新首席执行官，并宣布裁员数千人。

paragraphs.en: Xbox is pushing ahead, but as for what 2027 will bring, we'll have to wait and see. IGN got in on the anniversary festivities with a trip down memory lane with Ryan McCaffrey . If you’ve yet to see the nostalgic Original and 360 boot-up animations on your Xbox Series X/S or One consoles, they should become available at some point later today. For more, you can check out the new sequence added earlier this year .
paragraphs.cn: XBOX正在继续前进，但至于2027年会带来什么，我们还得拭目以待。IGN与Ryan McCaffrey一起回顾往昔，参与周年庆祝活动。如果你还没有在自己的XBOX Series或One主机上看到怀旧的初代和360开机动画，它们应该会在今天晚些时候的某个时间上线。想了解更多，你可以看看今年早些时候加入的新开机动画。
